turns.question: How much did bookings grow in the week of 14 September 2026 compared with the previous week?
turns.answer: Bookings grew 27.3% in the week of 14 September 2026 (the 7 days from 14 to 20 September) compared with the previous week, a week-over-week growth share of 0.27. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
